title: Kim Kardashian reveals how she found out someone 'close to her' put a hit on her life - NewsBreak
text:
By Scarlett O'Toole ,
38 minutes ago Kim Kardashian has revealed she found out someone "extremely close" to her put a hit on her life after a meeting with an attorney.
The 45-year-old broke down in tears as she recalled the terrifying experience on the latest episode of The Kardashians. Kim was filmed on the show studying for the California bar exam, which she's just found out she failed .
Speaking to the cameras, Kim admitted, "I am feeling… a little bit overwhelmed. Like this week, just so many things were happening that were like crazy, life-altering. And I'm like, I don’t have time to deal with it." A producer then asked if she wanted to open up about what's been going on in her life .

READ MORE: David Muir halts show for 'heartbreaking update' as he makes ABC World News Tonight return
"Oh just like, someone from prison was like, 'This person put a hit out on your life.' You know, so just like, stuff like that," Kim revealed as she fought back tears. She explained more in a confessional.
The mom-of-four told the cameras, "I got a call from an attorney that was hearing from the guys inside that there was a hit out on me. They said someone extremely close to me that used to be in my life had put a hit out on my life. And so you take it seriously."
The episode then cut back to Kim studying for her exam as she revealed what she had to do after learning about the hit on her life. "It's just like all these things where it’s like, 'Okay, switch out all my cars, do this, don't drive here, don't go out," she shared.
In a voiceover, Kim admitted, "It was time-consuming because I had to meet with attorneys and investigators." She then told the cameras, "It was definitely scary. It was definitely scary to know, or to feel that, to feel that energy out there."
Kim explained how the person who put a hit on her life "just wanted some money and was gonna act like it was happening, that they were gonna stop it for you, just for like, you to be indebted to them."
Speaking in a confessional, the TV star admitted, "Whether it was real or not, just, um, took a toll on me that week. It was a lot. But then you have to move on." Kim didn't reveal who had put the hit out on her life.
Elsewhere in the episode, Kim opened up about how she felt about the thought of her new show, All's Fair, being ripped apart by critics. Sitting in her trailer on set, she admitted, "It's crazy that this journey is over," before opening up about her anxieties.
She told the camera, "Here's the thing, these shows, it is not guaranteed that it is gonna be a hit. So you put your heart and soul and your time into something and it’s like, what if it doesn’t hit? Then like, what was this for?"
Kim laughed as she continued, "I mean, obviously everything in life, you gotta take risks to get there, but I've taken all the risks. I’ve done all the… I’ve made it."
